verdict.rationale: Alloy's homepage claims "fully auditable agentic automation" for KYC/KYB, AML and fraud checks. That suggests an in-product agent with an audit trail over screening-type work, but it is a single marketing line. No docs describe an agent reviewing watchlist or screening matches or recording a per-decision rationale. Missing for 10: documented agent review of screening matches, an explicit recorded rationale per match decision, how-to or product docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a ai-native, I can use an in-product agent to review screening matches with recorded rationale

citations.quote: Streamline perpetual KYC/KYB, AML, and fraud checks with fully auditable agentic automation
